why_durable: The streak spans scheduled nightlies (days). Crons + session Monitors die with their session, and an in-session 'cycle N' summary is the last-surviving-copy trap. This committed file is the ONLY carrier that survives session ends. The cutover co-sign trigger reads THIS file, never an agent's in-session count.

definition.unit: consecutive clean SCHEDULED cycles (per OPAL_CONSOLIDATION_PRD.md:181 -- 'N consecutive scheduled cycles')
definition.deliverable_scope: Each SCHEDULED cycle produces + verifies the FULL revamp deliverable = 7 keys: aggregate_aua_timeseries {49financial,inflection,global} + account_distribution {49financial,inflection,global} + non_model_assets (A4, global). account_distribution is ANDREW-MANDATED in-scope (2026-07-21, via 0.7.0_AE: 'account distributions per firm and globally as part of the REVAMP process, cloud-based, structured off the relevant assets in opal-data-assets'). aum_metrics + aum_timeseries = TO-2 (later wave; live-served by legacy until TO-2 replaces them off the aggregate; NOT in the streak).
definition.scheduled_only: A HAND-STAGED run does NOT count (NEVER rule: validate on the scheduled nightly's artifacts, not ad-hoc). The count advances ONLY on a scheduled-cycle artifact set that all THREE independent passes recorded CLEAN.
definition.reset_rule: An UNEXPLAINED delta in any pass RESETS the streak to 0/3 (PRD:184). A named delta (in DS's ledger) does NOT reset.
definition.no_silent_pass: A scheduled cycle with NO recorded 3-pass verification is NOT counted -- it is a GAP to fill, never a silent pass. Missing verification != clean.
definition.cutover_gate: streak == 3 clean scheduled cycles AND the never-widen co-sign package (CTO+COO+Andrew) -> then S5 cutover (arm publisher, gold->portal). Publisher stays OFF until this fires.
